_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: the verdict-to-counter switch is NOT independently testable (issue #1829)
expectedRed.why: On correct code the verdict-to-counter switch has been extracted into an independently testable pure function (consume-verdict.mts), so the structural assertion that it is NOT independently testable fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the switch was folded back into the untestable script body.
